what: `test_plan_review_panel.py` lists three surviving Makefile targets but does not assign which target owns `panel_dispatch`, `voter_dispatch`, and the registry catch-all
scenario_or_breakage: Today `test-plan-review-panel` and `test-dispatch-plan-review-panel` are both full-file reruns of the same seven tests; an implementer can slice both to `panel_dispatch` (or leave overlap) and still miss `test_plan_review_cli_registry_contains_panel_verbs`
suggested_fix: Bind explicitly: `test-dispatch-plan-review-panel` → `panel_dispatch`; `test-dispatch-plan-voters` → `voter_dispatch`; `test-plan-review-panel` → catch-all/registry only (e.g. `-k plan_review_cli_registry` or `not (...)` over the other two families)
